development.what: the ARC-AGI-1 training tasks the vocabulary was invented on: the DSL and its combinators were written against the training split, the solved programs of bench/verdicts/grid.json (167 tasks, never scored) are collapsed into words and are the development corpus of the sleep, and the train pairs of the scored timeouts are mined for partial programs offered to the OTHER scored tasks

heldOut.what: the ARC-AGI-1 training tasks the fixed vocabulary timed out on, scored in every arm; a word is never offered to the task it was mined or collapsed from, test outputs are read only to grade; the library arm is cross fitted: fold f is scored with a library slept on the development programs and the solved programs of the invented arm on the other fold only, and a word the prior imagined carries the tasks that fed it as sources, so the own program of no scored task shaped a word it was offered

split.contaminated: the scored tasks are training tasks the DSL and its combinators were written against, and the train pairs of each scored task were mined for words offered to the other scored tasks, never to itself; no test output of a scored task fed a word it was offered

workUnit: work ms: capability/grid-invent.mjs WORK_MS weighs the counted applications and cells of a search

bar.bound: the seed to seed band (the run to run band unmeasured)
